definition_zh: 精神创伤；心理创伤；外伤；损伤；心灵伤痛
definition_en: a deep emotional wound left by a shocking event, or a physical injury to the body
core_image: 一道深深的伤口：皮肉被划开，愈合了也留下长长的疤
scene: 地震过去很多年，她夜里仍会被倒塌声惊醒。Years after the earthquake, she still wakes at night at the sound of crumbling walls because of the trauma.
sceneCN: 这里 trauma 是「精神创伤」（第 1 个义项：强烈冲击事件留下的持久心理伤害）；句意：地震过去很多年，她夜里仍会被倒塌声惊醒。

pos.zh: 精神创伤；心理创伤；外伤；损伤

derivatives.zh: 基础词加形容词词尾 -ic 构成，义为「创伤性的；令人痛苦的」
基础词加动词词尾 -ise 构成，义为「使受精神创伤」
traumatise 加过去分词词尾 -ed 构成，义为「受创伤的」
基础词加学科词尾 -logy 构成，义为「创伤学」
traumatology 加人物词尾 -ist 构成，义为「创伤科医生」

senses.title: A deep emotional wound
senses.definition: lasting emotional and psychological damage caused by a shocking or violent event
senses.definitionCN: 由令人震惊或暴力的事件造成的持久情绪与心理伤害
senses.example: The survivors still carry the trauma of that night.
senses.exampleCN: 幸存者们至今仍带着那一夜的创伤。
senses.why: Greek trauma first meant a bodily wound, and psychology borrowed the same image for a wound in the mind that does not simply close.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 trauma 本指身体上的伤口，心理学借用了同一个画面，表示心里那道不会轻易愈合的伤口。

senses.title: A physical injury
senses.definition: damage to the body caused by an accident, a blow, or another outside force
senses.definitionCN: 由事故、撞击或其他外力造成的身体损伤
senses.example: The hospital has a unit for serious head trauma.
senses.exampleCN: 这家医院设有严重头部外伤的科室。
senses.why: The oldest sense is bodily: a wound or a blow that breaks the tissue, which is why hospitals and accident reports use the word.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义就是身体层面的：一道伤口或一次击打使组织受创，所以医院与事故报告里常用这个词。

senses.title: A shocking life event
senses.definition: an event so upsetting that it leaves lasting emotional effects on those who live through it
senses.definitionCN: 令人极度不安、会给经历者留下持久情绪影响的重大事件
senses.example: For the whole town, the flood was a collective trauma.
senses.exampleCN: 对整座城镇来说，那场洪水是一场集体性的创伤事件。
senses.why: By a common extension the word also names the event itself, because the blow and the wound it leaves are hard to separate in memory.
senses.whyCN: 这个词还常被用来指事件本身，因为击打与留下的伤口在记忆里难以分开，口语中便以伤代因。

senses.title: A lasting emotional scar
senses.definition: a painful memory or sense of being hurt that stays with someone long after the event
senses.definitionCN: 事件过去很久后仍留在人心里的一种痛苦记忆或被伤害的感觉
senses.example: Years later he still spoke of the family debts as a trauma.
senses.exampleCN: 多年以后，他仍把家里的债务称作一道创痛。
senses.why: Here trauma is looser and more literary: any enduring sore spot that keeps hurting, not necessarily a clinical injury.
senses.whyCN: 这里的用法更宽泛、更文学化：任何持续作痛的痛处，不一定是临床意义上的损伤，所以译作「创痛」更贴切。

intro.en: Trauma comes from ancient Greek trauma, a wound, and its verb titroskein meant to wound. Both the physical and the mental sense rest on the same picture of a break in the tissue.
intro.cn: trauma 来自古希腊语 trauma（伤口），同源动词意为「刺伤」。身体与心理两个义项都建立在「组织被划开」这同一个画面上。

items.en: The root ter- with the meaning to rub or pierce is usually traced behind the Greek word.
items.cn: 一般认为希腊词背后有意为「摩擦、刺穿」的词根 ter-，此处为重构形式，存疑。

items.en: Trauma means a wound in the Iliad and in later medical writing, where Hippocrates treats it as a break in the body.
items.cn: 在《伊利亚特》与后世医学写作中 trauma 都指伤口，希波克拉底用它表示身体的破损。

items.en: Medical Latin adopts trauma as a technical name for a wound.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语吸收 trauma，作为「创伤」的专门术语。

items.en: English borrows the word from medical Latin to describe physical injury.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪借入此词，先用于描述身体损伤。

items.en: Victorian surgeons and early neurologists extend the word to shocks of the nervous system.
items.cn: 十九世纪的外科医生与早期神经学家把词义扩展到神经系统的震荡。

items.en: Psychology gives trauma its dominant modern sense of emotional damage that lasts.
items.cn: 现代心理学让 trauma 获得最主流的现代义：持久的情绪伤害。

note.en: Trauma names the wound itself, while its neighbours describe the event, the feeling, or the medical treatment around it.
note.cn: trauma 指伤口本身，而相邻的词描述的是事件、感受或围绕它的医学处理。

entries.definition: causing deep emotional shock or injury
entries.definitionCN: 造成精神创伤的；外伤的

entries.definition: to make someone suffer lasting emotional shock
the branch of medicine dealing with wounds and injuries
a sudden and very upsetting experience
an injury, or a hurt to the feelings
great suffering of mind or body

normalIntro.en: Treat trauma as a wound in the tissue: the word came from Greek medicine, and psychology simply moved the same image inward.
normalIntro.cn: 把 trauma 记成组织上的伤口：它本是希腊医学词，心理学只是把同一幅画面搬进了内心。

normal.en: Trauma and wound are old partners: both name a break in living tissue.
normal.cn: trauma 与 wound 是老搭档：都指活体组织被划开的破损。

normal.en: The adjective traumatic adds -ic, just as in dramatic or emphatic.
normal.cn: 形容词 traumatic 加 -ic，和 dramatic、emphatic 的构词方式相同。

normal.en: Childhood trauma locates the old wound in early family life.
normal.cn: childhood trauma 把旧伤口定位在早年的家庭生活里。

normal.en: A trauma center treats physical wounds after accidents and disasters.
normal.cn: trauma center 是事故与灾难后处理身体创伤的急救中心。

normal.en: The medical plural traumata keeps the Greek ending, while the everyday plural is much simpler.
normal.cn: 医学复数是 traumata，保留希腊语词尾；日常复数则简单得多。

abstract.en: Picture a crack in a wall that the paint never quite hides.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上有一条裂缝，油漆怎么刷也盖不住。

abstract.en: Imagine a knee that still aches whenever the weather turns cold.
abstract.cn: 想象一只膝盖，每逢天冷还会隐隐作痛。

abstract.en: Think of a scar that fades in colour but never disappears.
abstract.cn: 想象一道疤痕，颜色淡了却从不完全消失。

examples.en: The firefighter still has nightmares because of the trauma of that rescue.
examples.cn: 那名消防员因那次救援的创伤至今仍做噩梦。

examples.en: Doctors classified the injuries as severe chest trauma.
examples.cn: 医生把伤情判定为严重的胸部外伤。

examples.en: Counsellors help children deal with trauma after a disaster.
examples.cn: 心理咨询师帮助孩子们应对灾难后的创伤。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿抹」——手术刀穿过皮肉一抹，就留下一道伤口；这只是拆音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古希腊语 trauma（伤口）→ 医学拉丁语 trauma → 英语 trauma，核心义由「皮肉之伤」引申为「心中之伤」。

sensesIntro.en: Trauma keeps the shape of a wound: it begins as physical injury, moves to the mind, and loosens to cover an event or a lasting sore memory.
sensesIntro.cn: trauma 始终保留「伤口」的形状：先从身体外伤出发，转向精神创伤，再放宽到指事件本身或持久的创痛记忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a deep wound that closes over but leaves a scar.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道深伤口，表面愈合却留下疤痕。

branches.en: The psychological sense is the core modern meaning.
branches.cn: 心理层面的精神创伤是现代核心义。

branches.en: The bodily sense keeps the oldest medical use alive.
branches.cn: 身体层面的外伤保留着最早的医学用法。

branches.en: The event sense uses the blow for the wound it causes.
branches.cn: 事件义用「击打」代指它造成的伤口。

branches.en: The loose sense covers any lasting sore memory.
branches.cn: 宽泛义覆盖任何持久的痛处与记忆。

branches.en: A serious accident often wounds body and mind at once.
branches.cn: 严重事故常常同时伤及身体与心灵。

intro.en: Trauma is a bare Greek noun, so its families grow with suffixes like -ic, -ise, and -logy rather than with prefixes.
intro.cn: trauma 是一个不带前缀的希腊名词，所以它的词族依靠 -ic、-ise、-logy 这类后缀生长，而不是靠前缀。

latinIntro.en: The trail runs from Greek trauma through medical Latin trauma; the Greek verb titroskein shares the wound image.
latinIntro.cn: 这条词源线索从希腊语 trauma 经医学拉丁语 trauma 进入英语，希腊语动词「刺伤」共享同一个伤口意象。

items.example: Greek trauma names a physical wound.
items.exampleCN: 希腊语 trauma 指身体上的伤口。

items.example: Medical Latin keeps trauma as a technical term.
items.exampleCN: 医学拉丁语保留下 trauma 这一术语。
词尾 -ic 构成 traumatic。
traumatic 形容令人受创的经历。
词尾 -ise 构成 traumatise。
战争会使整个社区受创。
词尾 -logy 构成 traumatology。

items.example: Traumatology studies injuries to the body.
items.exampleCN: 创伤学研究身体损伤。
词尾 -ist 构成 traumatologist。
创伤科医生治疗严重损伤。

definition_zh: 横穿；穿过；横越；横跨；遍历
definition_en: to travel across or pass over an area, a surface, or a length of space
core_image: 一条脚印从左到右横贯整片雪地，一直踩到另一头
scene: 护林员背着冰镐，用一整天横穿那片结冰的湖面去营地。The ranger spent a whole day traversing the frozen lake to reach the camp.
sceneCN: 这里 traverse 是「横穿」（第 1 个义项：从一端穿越到另一端）；句意：护林员背着冰镐，用了一整天横穿那片结冰的湖面去营地。

derivatives.zh: traverse 加名词词尾 -al 构成，义为「穿越；遍历」
traverse 加形容词词尾 -able 构成，义为「可通过的」
traverse 加施事词尾 -er 构成，义为「穿越者；横过者」
traversable 加否定前缀 non- 构成，义为「无法穿越的」

senses.title: To travel across a place
senses.definition: to go from one side of a region, a country, or a stretch of land to the other
senses.definitionCN: 从一片地区、一个国家或一段土地的一侧走到另一侧
senses.example: They traversed the desert in a week.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一周时间横穿了沙漠。
senses.why: French traverser means to cross, and the Latin source transversare points to a line drawn sideways across something, so the verb is all about crossing the whole width.
senses.whyCN: 法语 traverser 意为「横过」，拉丁语来源暗示一条横着画过去的线，所以这个动词的核心就是走完整个宽度。

senses.title: To pass over a surface
senses.definition: to walk or move over a surface, a bridge, or an opening such as a gorge
senses.definitionCN: 在某个表面、桥面或深谷等开口上走过、移动过
senses.example: The hikers traversed the wooden bridge one by one.
senses.exampleCN: 徒步者们一个接一个走过木桥。
senses.why: The picture narrows to a single surface between two edges, so the verb fits bridges, ledges, and plank walkways.
senses.whyCN: 画面收窄为两侧有边、中间是一条表面的东西，所以桥、岩架、木板道都用这个词。

senses.title: To survey by going across
senses.definition: to measure or examine a line of land by running a line across it, as surveyors do
senses.definitionCN: 像测量员那样沿横线测量或勘察一条地带
senses.example: The surveyors traversed the field to map its borders.
senses.exampleCN: 测量员横穿田野，以绘制边界。
senses.why: Surveying names a traverse as the line run across a district, which turns the crossing motion into a technical measuring act.
senses.whyCN: 测量学里把横贯一片区域的线叫作 traverse，于是横穿的动作变成了一个技术性的测量行为。

senses.title: To go through point by point
senses.definition: to pass through a series of points, files, or entries, especially in a systematic order
senses.definitionCN: 依次穿过程序中的一系列点、文件或条目，尤指按系统顺序
senses.example: The program traverses every folder on the disk.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序会遍历磁盘上的每一个文件夹。
senses.why: Computing borrows the crossing image for a path that visits each node of a tree or graph in turn.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域借用了「横穿」的画面，表示一条路径依次访问树或图的每个节点。

intro.en: Traverse traces back through Old French traverser to Latin transversare, to turn across, from trans- meaning across plus vertere, to turn.
intro.cn: traverse 经古法语 traverser 上溯到拉丁语 transversare（横转过去），由表示「横过」的 trans- 与意为「转动」的 vertere 组成。

items.en: The root wer- meaning to turn is usually reconstructed behind the Latin verb.
items.cn: 一般认为拉丁动词背后有意为「转动」的词根 wer-，此处为重构形式。

items.en: Trans means across, vertere means to turn, and transversus means turned across; transversare is the verb built on it.
items.cn: trans 意为「横过」，vertere 意为「转动」，transversus 意为「横着的」，动词 transversare 由此构成。

items.en: Traverser means to cross or to go through, and the noun travers names a crossing.
items.cn: 古法语 traverser 意为「横过、穿过」，名词 travers 指横穿。

items.en: English takes traverse in the fifteenth century in the senses of crossing and of a crossbar.
items.cn: 英语于十五世纪借入 traverse，既可指横穿，也可指横木。

items.en: Military, surveying, and computing uses expand the word in later centuries.
items.cn: 后来的军事、测量与计算机用法让这个词的范围不断扩大。

note.en: Traverse is the formal verb for crossing, and it sits close to traverser, traversal, and to the plain crossing words.
note.cn: traverse 是表示「穿越」的较正式动词，与 traverser、traversal 以及朴素的「越过」类词相邻。

entries.definition: a person or thing that crosses an area
the act of crossing or moving through something
possible to cross
lying across something, not along it
entries.definitionCN: 横向的（同出 trans- 与转动词根）

entries.definition: to go from one side of something to the other
to find the way through a difficult route
to stretch across from one side to the other

normalIntro.en: Hold onto the picture of a line drawn sideways across a map: trans- gives across and vertere gives turn, and traverse is the walk along that line.
normalIntro.cn: 抓住「在地图上横画一条线」这个画面：trans- 表示横过，vertere 表示转动，traverse 就是沿着这条线走过去。

normal.en: Transverse is the adjective sibling: it describes something lying across.
normal.cn: 同根形容词 transverse 形容横着摆放的东西。

normal.en: Converse, reverse, and traverse all keep the turning root.
normal.cn: converse、reverse 与 traverse 都保留了「转动」这个词根。

normal.en: Traverse the desert is the classic use: crossing the whole width.
normal.cn: traverse the desert 是经典用法：横穿整个宽度。

normal.en: A traverse in climbing is a sideways move along the rock face.
normal.cn: 攀岩里的 traverse 指沿岩壁的横向移动。

normal.en: Software traversal visits each node of a structure in turn.
normal.cn: 软件里的 traversal 指依次访问结构的每个节点。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint line cutting straight across a snowfield.
abstract.cn: 想象一串脚印笔直地横切过一片雪地。

abstract.en: Imagine a tightrope walker crossing the whole gap without looking down.
abstract.cn: 想象走钢丝的人横越整个空隙而不往下看。

abstract.en: Think of a red pencil stroke drawn across a page from edge to edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一支红笔在纸页上从一边画到另一边。

examples.en: The expedition traversed the glacier in three days.
examples.cn: 探险队用三天时间穿越了冰川。

examples.en: A new railway traverses the mountain range to the north.
examples.cn: 一条新铁路横越北面的山脉。

examples.en: Birdwatchers traversed the whole island to find the rare warbler.
examples.cn: 观鸟者走遍全岛，寻找那种罕见的莺。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿窝死」——硬要横穿鸟窝，结果撞得头破血流；这只是拆音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（横过）+ vertere（转动）→ transversus（横着的）→ transversare → 古法语 traverser → 英语 traverse，核心义「横着转过去」。

sensesIntro.en: Traverse always means going across: first across land, then across a surface, then along a measuring line, and finally across points in a sequence.
sensesIntro.cn: traverse 始终表示「横过」：先横穿陆地，再走过表面，然后沿测量线走过，最后穿过序列中的各个点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a line of footprints cutting straight across a field.
core.cn: 核心意象：一串脚印笔直横穿田野。

branches.en: Crossing a whole region is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 横穿整片区域是日常义项。

branches.en: Crossing a surface such as a bridge is the narrower sense.
branches.cn: 走过桥面等表面是更窄的义项。

branches.en: The surveying sense turns the crossing into measurement.
branches.cn: 测量义把横穿变成一个测绘动作。

branches.en: The computing sense turns the path into a sequence of points.
branches.cn: 计算机义把路径变成点的序列。

branches.en: Both senses end with every point covered along the way.
branches.cn: 两个义项都以沿途覆盖每一个点为结果。

intro.en: Traverse is built from the Latin prefix trans- and the root vertere, so its word family and its near cousins both keep the idea of turning across.
intro.cn: traverse 由拉丁语前缀 trans- 与词根 vertere 构成，因此它的词族与近邻词都保留「横着转过去」的意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans- means across and vertere means to turn; together they give transversare, the direct source of the English verb.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trans- 表示横过，vertere 表示转动，两者合成 transversare，正是英语动词的直接来源。

items.example: The prefix trans- gives the crossing idea.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 trans- 提供「横过」的意象。

items.example: Vertere is the turning root of the family.
items.exampleCN: vertere 是这个词族里表示转动的词根。
transversus 产生形容词 transverse。
traverse 保留了横穿的含义。
词尾 -al 构成 traversal。

items.example: Traversal names the process of crossing.
items.exampleCN: traversal 表示穿越的过程。
词尾 -able 构成 traversable。
traversable 形容可通行的路线。
词尾 -er 构成 traverser。

items.example: A traverser moves right across the land.
items.exampleCN: traverser 指横穿整片土地的人。

definition_zh: 跑步机；踏车；枯燥单调的工作；监狱踏车
definition_en: a machine with a moving belt for walking or running in place, or any dull routine that feels endless
core_image: 一个人不停迈步，脚下的轮子一直在转，人却停在原地
scene: 清早健身房里人还不多，她照例先热身，再踏上转带跑上四十分钟。Every morning she runs for forty minutes on the treadmill at the gym.
sceneCN: 这里 treadmill 是「跑步机」（第 1 个义项：带转带、可在原地跑动的健身器械）；句意：清早健身房里人还不多，她照例先热身，再踏上转带跑上四十分钟。

pos.zh: 跑步机；踏车；枯燥单调的工作；监狱踏车

collocations.zh: 跑台试验；运动负荷试验

derivatives.zh: 构词要素之一，义为「踩；踏」，与「用脚踩踏」的核心动作直接相关
构词要素之一，义为「磨坊；研磨机」，与「磨」的核心画面直接相关
与 mill 同族的复合词，义为「磨盘」，同属「磨」的意象
与 tread 同族，义为「踏板」，同出「踩踏」这一词源

senses.title: A fitness machine
senses.definition: a machine with a wide moving belt on which people walk or run while staying in one place
senses.definitionCN: 带有一条宽运动带的机器，人可在其上行走或跑步而留在原地
senses.example: He sets the treadmill to a gentle incline.
senses.exampleCN: 他把跑步机调到缓坡。
senses.why: A treadmill is literally something tread by the foot plus a mill, so the fitness machine keeps the image of feet turning a mill wheel in place.
senses.whyCN: treadmill 字面就是「用脚踩 + 磨机」，健身器保留了「双脚踩动磨轮却停在原地」的画面。

senses.title: Dull endless routine
senses.titleCN: 枯燥单调的工作；无休止的循环
senses.definition: a tiring routine or way of life that repeats without progress and feels hard to escape
senses.definitionCN: 不断重复、毫无进展、令人疲惫且难以摆脱的日常或生活方式
senses.example: Many workers feel trapped in the nine to five treadmill.
senses.exampleCN: 许多上班族觉得自己困在朝九晚五的循环里。
senses.why: Because a mill keeps turning while nothing new comes out, the word grew into a metaphor for effort that never moves you forward.
senses.whyCN: 因为磨机转个不停却磨不出新东西，这个词就引申为「再怎么出力也不向前」的忙碌。

senses.title: The prison treadwheel
senses.definition: a heavy wheel driven only by prisoners walking on its steps, used as a punishment
senses.definitionCN: 只靠囚犯在踏板上行走驱动的沉重轮子，用作惩罚手段
senses.example: Victorian prisons made inmates climb the treadmill for hours.
senses.exampleCN: 维多利亚时代的监狱让囚犯在踏车上攀走数小时。
senses.why: In the early nineteenth century the word named a real prison wheel, which is the historical bridge between the mill and the gym.
senses.whyCN: 十九世纪初这个词就指真实的监狱踏轮，它正是「磨机」与「健身器」之间的历史桥梁。

senses.title: A rotation device
senses.definition: any wheel or mill turned by a person or an animal walking on its outer surface
senses.definitionCN: 由人或畜在其外缘行走而带动的任何轮子或磨具
senses.example: Farmers once used a treadmill driven by a patient donkey.
senses.exampleCN: 从前农民用一头耐心的驴驱动踏轮。
senses.why: The oldest machine sense is general: a wheel turned by treading, used to grind grain or pump water.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的机械义是泛指：靠踩踏驱动、用来磨粒或抽水的轮子。

intro.en: Treadmill joins two Old English ideas: tredan, to tread, and myln, a mill. The compound first named a wheel turned by feet, later a prison wheel, and only in the twentieth century a fitness machine.
intro.cn: treadmill 由两个古英语概念合成：意为「踩踏」的 tredan 与意为「磨坊」的 myln。这个复合词先指靠脚踏转动的轮子，再指监狱踏轮，直到二十世纪才指健身器。

items.en: Tredan means to tread or step on, and myln means a mill borrowed from Latin molinum.
items.cn: tredan 意为踩踏，myln 意为磨坊，后者借自拉丁语 molinum。

items.en: A treadmill is first recorded as a mill turned by animals or people treading a wheel.
items.cn: 此词最早记录为靠人畜踩踏轮子驱动的磨机。

items.en: In the 1820s treadmills are introduced into prisons as a form of hard labour.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代，踏车被引入监狱，作为一种苦役。

items.en: After the treadmills are abolished in prisons, the word passes to exercise machines.
items.cn: 监狱取消踏车后，这个词转而指健身器械。

items.en: The figurative sense of a joyless routine grows from the prison and mill images.
items.cn: 「枯燥循环」的比喻义由磨机与监狱的画面生长出来。

note.en: Treadmill is a compound, so its look-alikes are the two words inside it plus close compounds and its near meanings.
note.cn: treadmill 是一个复合词，所以形近组是它内部的两个词与相近的复合词，近义组则围绕「跑步」与「循环」。

entries.definition: to put your foot down on something
a building with machines for grinding grain
a lever pressed by the foot to work a machine
a mill powered by wind-driven sails
a fixed set of actions repeated daily
hard dull work that never seems to end
a stationary bike used for indoor training

normalIntro.en: Treadmill is two words joined: foot plus mill. Keep the mill wheel in view and both the gym and the dull routine make sense.
normalIntro.cn: treadmill 是两个词拼起来的：脚 + 磨机。记住那口磨轮，健身器与枯燥循环两种意思就都说得通了。

normal.en: Tread means to step, and treadle keeps that foot sense.
normal.cn: tread 意为踩踏，treadle 保留了这种用脚的意味。

normal.en: Mill also gives millstone, the heavy wheel of a grinding machine.
normal.cn: mill 也构成 millstone，指磨机的沉重磨盘。

normal.en: On the treadmill leaves you in one place while the belt moves.
normal.cn: on the treadmill 让你皮带在动、人却待在原地。

normal.en: A treadmill test in medicine measures the heart under walking load.
normal.cn: 医学上的 treadmill test 测量步行负荷下的心脏状况。

normal.en: The prison treadmill was hard labour with no product, which feeds the figurative sense.
normal.cn: 监狱踏车是没有产出的苦役，这正是比喻义的来源。

abstract.en: Picture a hamster wheel spinning fast while the hamster stays put.
abstract.cn: 想象一只仓鼠飞快地跑轮，却始终停在原地。

abstract.en: Imagine a millstone turning all night and producing just dust.
abstract.cn: 想象一口磨盘整夜转动，只磨出一点尘土。

abstract.en: Think of a stairway that moves down as fast as you climb.
abstract.cn: 想象一道楼梯，你上得越快它就往下退得越快。

examples.en: She keeps a treadmill in the spare room for winter runs.
examples.cn: 她在空房间里放了一台跑步机，冬天用来跑步。

examples.en: Repairing the same three faults each day became a treadmill.
examples.cn: 每天修同样的三处故障，成了一个无休止的循环。

examples.en: The museum shows the treadmill prisoners once climbed.
examples.cn: 博物馆展出了当年囚犯攀走的踏车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「追的米漏」——追着漏出来的米跑，跑得再快也追不到，正是原地打转的感觉；这只是拆音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语 tredan（踩踏）+ myln（磨坊，借自拉丁语 molinum）→ treadmill，先指脚踏磨轮，再指监狱踏车，最后指健身跑步机，引申为「原地打转的循环」。

sensesIntro.en: Treadmill begins as a wheel moved by feet, becomes a machine of punishment, then a gym device, and finally any routine that turns without progress.
sensesIntro.cn: treadmill 从「靠脚踩动的轮子」出发，先成为惩罚性的监狱器具，再成为健身器械，最后泛指原地打转的循环。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone stepping forever while the wheel turns under the feet.
core.cn: 核心意象：人不停迈步，脚下的轮子一直在转，人却原地不动。

branches.en: The gym machine is the everyday modern sense.
branches.cn: 健身跑步机是当今最日常的义项。

branches.en: The dull routine is the figurative sense.
branches.cn: 枯燥循环是比喻义项。

branches.en: The prison wheel is the historical sense.
branches.cn: 监狱踏车是历史义项。

branches.en: The rotation device is the general machine sense.
branches.cn: 踏轮装置是泛指的机械义项。

branches.en: The punishment wheel and the empty routine share the same pointless turning.
branches.cn: 惩罚踏轮与空转日常共享同一种没有结果的转动。

intro.en: Treadmill is an English compound, not a word with Latin affixes, so its family is built from tread and mill and the compounds they form.
intro.cn: treadmill 是英语复合词，并非带拉丁词缀的词，所以它的词族由 tread 与 mill 以及它们构成的复合词组成。

latinIntro.en: Only one half is Latin in origin: mill comes from Latin molinum, a mill, while tread is native Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 只有一半有拉丁来源：mill 来自拉丁语 molinum（磨坊），而 tread 是古英语本族词。

items.example: Tread is the foot half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: tread 是这个复合词里「脚」的一半。

items.example: Mill is the turning half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: mill 是这个复合词里「转动」的一半。
treadle 共享 tread 的词根。
millstone 沿用「磨」的意象。

items.example: Treading keeps the foot action as a noun.
items.exampleCN: treading 把踩踏动作变成名词。

items.example: Windmill also pairs a power source with mill.
items.exampleCN: windmill 同样把动力来源与 mill 组合。

items.meaning: a machine for walking in place
items.exampleCN: treadmill 把两半合在一起。

items.meaningCN: 表示单调循环场所的成分
items.example: Diploma mill extends mill as a suffix.
items.exampleCN: diploma mill 把 mill 当作后缀来用。
